name: YUCLAW Evidence API
former_name_status: deprecated compatibility alias: kept so that clients which matched the earlier service name keep resolving it; it is not a product claim and not current positioning — the current name is the `name` field
positioning: The open evidence layer for financial AI.

wildcard_discovery.ledger_day: GET /evidence/verify.json and read days[].date; the latest date is the representative
wildcard_discovery.evidence_changes_day: GET /c6_posture_current.json and read as_of; that date is the latest daily file; earlier days are one file per UTC day back to 2026-07-29; a 404 means no block for that day

endpoint_case: JSON endpoints are case-sensitive: {TICKER} is uppercase (why/NVDA.json — why/nvda.json is a 404); the CLI uppercases ticker arguments for you

formats.evidencebench: JSONL — one item per line: {item_id, template (T1|T2|T3), question, key}; /evidencebench/meta.json carries the item-set hash and scoring rule

cli.check_claim: yuclaw check-claim --ticker X --type T --date-range A..B  (or --text '...', or --accession N alone when the accession maps to one name)

as_of_recipe: Load /why/{TICKER}.json for history_url and history_manifest_url. Use ONLY the COMPLETE history file whose build_id, SHA-256, byte count and object count match the manifest. Filter available_as_of <= D after normalizing timestamps to UTC; a date-only D means 23:59:59.999999 UTC. Do not substitute filing_date or generated. A capped PREVIEW returns INCOMPLETE unless returned equals total_available; it cannot establish zero historical evidence. D outside corpus_start/corpus_end returns OUT_OF_RANGE. Classification at D uses the label_history entry with the maximum eligible date, not list order. Before that ribbon, use yuclaw replay TICKER --date D on a research backend.
not_advice: Research and education only — not investment advice. Signal labels are research classifications, not buy/sell recommendations. Investment implication: none established — no buy, sell, or alpha conclusion is supported by this object.
